title: Transport in the Future
subtitle: 考点：未来预测 / will / traffic
passage: How will people travel in 2060? Many experts believe that cities will have much less traffic. Instead of private cars, people will use public transport such as fast trains and electric buses. These systems will be more efficient, and they will cost less money.

Technology will also change cars. Some cars will drive themselves, so people can read or watch videos on the way to work. Some experts say that small flying cars may appear in big cities, but they will probably be too expensive for most people at first.

Will everything be better? Not always. New technology needs a lot of electricity, and it must be safe. Still, most experts are positive. “Good transport will save people time and protect the planet,” says one researcher. Students in Class 8 will have a chance to see these changes during their lifetime.
